thread:
Anya (Design): Pushed a tiny update for the Create API Key modal in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd. Need quick consensus: default expiry, 'Never' prominence, role checklist order, and warning wording. Trying to ship a polish tomorrow.

Sam C (Product): Default 90 days. Keep Never but secondary. If Admin + Never then require a confirmation checkbox.

Kevin (Eng): Dev notes: fetch secret only on reveal, never render in HTML initially. Copy tooltip should be short ("Copied"). We'll emit an event if 'Never' chosen.

Liz (Accessibility): A11y nits: dynamic aria-labels for reveal button ("Reveal API key"/"Hide API key"), use aria-live="polite" for copy confirmation, tie expiry warning to expiry control with aria-describedby, and ensure tab order: scopes before expiry.

Anya (Design): Draft warning: "This key will not expire. Long-lived keys increase exposure if leaked — rotate regularly and limit scopes." Keep it short. Where should the role checklist sit relative to expiry?

Sam C (Product): Checklist before expiry so users pick scopes then expiry. Also, make Never visually lighter and add checkbox label: "I acknowledge this key will never expire and may increase risk." for Admin+Never.

Kevin (Eng): We'll implement the checkbox. For reveal button we'll avoid aria-pressed; change aria-label on click and add sr-only expiry info when copying.

Liz (Accessibility): Agree on changing aria-label rather than aria-pressed. Checkbox needs aria-describedby linking to the warning. I'll run a quick keyboard + SR pass after design update.

Anya (Design): OK updating Figma: default 90d, move scopes up, de-emphasize Never, add Admin+Never confirm checkbox, update warning per Sam. Will post screenshot tomorrow AM. @Liz please smoke test then.

deploy-bot: Archived related thread 1819999999 for reference.

Sam C (Product): One extra: show relative expiry in selector and expose absolute date in sr-only and in the copied tooltip (e.g., "Copied — expires 2026-06-30") when not Never.

Kevin (Eng): Fine. We'll compute absolute date client-side and include sr-only and telemetry. Keep secrets ephemeral in memory.

Anya (Design): Thanks team, will iterate and ping. :sparkles:
